title: Keto Indian Tahini Chicken
description: A flavorful keto dish combining the richness of Indian spices with the creaminess of tahini, served with grilled chicken.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, garam masala, and curry powder.
Brush the grill with infused oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the chicken cooks, mix tahini with 1 tablespoon of water to thin it out.
Once the chicken is cooked, brush it with the tahini mixture.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
